agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime are zero Experience.

Under v2.1, DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are intended to remain operational progress only and must not become verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance evidence.

v2.1 strict-bool checks for secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and direct event_independently_verified are valid type hardening only; they do not establish provenance, freshness or verifier authority.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only; keeping it observational is acceptable until independently derived and adversarially validated.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly labels speedup NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED and v2 pressure as an engineering heuristic.
formal_mutation_allowed remains false and P_base remains read-only.

disagreements.finding: New material delta: Gearbox v2 computes real_experience_claim_allowed from positive verified event credit plus event kind, but does not require verification_stage=C_VERIFIED. A caller can therefore set event_kind=VERIFIED_RECOVERY and event_independently_verified=True while verification_stage remains UNVERIFIED/CANDIDATE/BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED, and v2 can still emit real_experience_claim_allowed=true. Existing v2 tests exercise the positive case only with C_VERIFIED and do not cover this cross-condition.
disagreements.required_change: Authoritative real/verified Experience eligibility must require an exact trusted verifier/C acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope/evidence and a compatible canonical verification stage. A boolean independently_verified flag is insufficient. Without a valid receipt and stage binding, real_experience_claim_allowed must be false and verified credit must be zero or analytics-only.

disagreements.finding: Public v2 still exposes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND through experience_candidate_delta although v2.1 contract classifies them operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Unify v2/v2.1 authoritative classification; operational events must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller declarations. Strict bool proves type only, not source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, policy or runtime/install binding.
disagreements.required_change: Consume typed SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope bound to source, scope, freshness, policy and runtime/install identity.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict merely neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project the exact trusted authority snapshot; stale/revoked/cross-scope authority evidence fails closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum support, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying necessary safe upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure throughput or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still requires only event kind plus a boolean in current executable paths; exact evidence hash, trusted verifier identity and receipt are not mandatory.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only within one aggregate invocation; same evidence under new IDs, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Both credit classes must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND receive operational credit without durable artifact/defect evidence receipt or lineage binding.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound operational acceptance receipt before nonzero operational credit; raw caller-only claims get zero.

disagreements.finding: v1 supports N/R; v2.1 unconditionally parses selected[1:] as an integer, so standby/rollback safety paths can crash.
disagreements.required_change: Treat N/R as terminal control states before G-gear parsing; anti-thrash must never delay rollback/standby semantics.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline protocol establishes speedup; commit count, wake count or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen numerator/denominator provenance, exposure/censoring/order, full assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: real_experience_claim_allowed can currently disagree with verification_stage, contaminating longitudinal labels and any downstream calibration using that flag as ground truth.
Caller-declared secretary freshness or authority conflict invalidates causal routing comparisons.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have high variance and can false-trigger/chatter around a single threshold.
Anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle/closure/recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later wired from policy-created progress back into upshift decisions.
Transient event identity and direct decision-path credit can inflate longitudinal verified/operational totals.
Operational-vs-Experience semantics differ between public v2 and v2.1 interfaces, making mixed-consumer metrics incomparable.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
durable_progress_per_wake is numerator/denominator-sensitive; verified_closure_per_hour is exposure/censoring-sensitive; fixed order and completed-only analysis create carryover/survivorship bias.
proposed_tests: GB21-REAL-EXPERIENCE-STAGE-079: event_kind=VERIFIED_RECOVERY + independently_verified=True with verification_stage in UNVERIFIED/CANDIDATE/BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED must yield real_experience_claim_allowed=false and no authoritative verified credit absent exact trusted acceptance receipt.
GB21-REAL-EXPERIENCE-RECEIPT-080: C_VERIFIED label without exact valid C/independent-verifier receipt must still fail closed; stale/revoked/cross-mission/cross-installation receipt must be rejected.
GB21-V2-V21-CLASSIFIER-CONSISTENCY-078: every event kind must have the same verified-vs-operational semantics across authoritative v2/v2.1 interfaces.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery projects G1 even when fallback caller kwargs are permissive.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift history, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen metric provenance, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.
release_condition: No formal adoption or speedup claim from this research review alone.

real_experience_claim_allowed and verified Experience credit must be derived from exact trusted verifier/C acceptance evidence plus canonical verification-stage binding; caller booleans or labels alone are insufficient.
Authoritative v2/v2.1 event semantics must be unified: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational-only everywhere.
Secretary freshness/provenance must be evidence-bound; fresh authority must be projected from an exact trusted decision, not a caller boolean.
Anti-thrash inputs must be canonically derived with adequate sample support, uncertainty and hysteretic release; cycle/closure/recovery performance must be non-inferior.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and tested against feedback/self-reinforcement.
All verified Experience requires exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt.
Event/evidence acceptance must be durable, rollback-resistant, lineage-aware and exactly-once across restart/poll/replay.
Operational progress must be evidence-bound and exactly-once; unsupported caller-only operational claims get zero credit.
Credit weights 5/4/3/1 remain heuristic and cannot be used as capability/Trust/Identity/Personality truth or promotion thresholds.

Speedup requires sealed matched-workload paired/crossover evidence using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance, exposure/censoring/order/coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
Heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/window age remain zero Experience; P_base remains read-only; Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 verified foundation remain preserved.
small_world_return_rule: After durable review write + fresh readback, return to Always-on Runtime / Small-World; write no research turn unless exact endpoint names QUANTUM.
